headline: Stable positive sentiment (score: +7.5)
key_insights: Optimism trending up 64% over 7 days (strong momentum)
sentiment_commentary:
• Fears leads today despite only 40 quotes, but with relatively few strong-intensity quotes (9 of 40), the score is dragged down to -17.2 — reflecting low engagement rather than active anxiety.
• All three categories are sitting in the lower portion of their 308-day ranges, suggesting today is a quieter-than-usual day across the board.
• Frustrations improved notably from yesterday (-13.5 to -5.9) and carries the most volume at 97 quotes with nearly half at strong intensity, hinting at some underlying venting even as the overall mood stays muted.
methodology: See METHODOLOGY.md. Scores use z-score normalization with empirically-derived intensity weights from analytics_config.yaml. Alerts at |z| >= threshold (configurable, default 2.0 for p < 0.05).
